May 14, 2018 - By olga
BGC Partners Inc (BGCP) investors sentiment decreased to 1.25 in 2017 Q4 . It’s down -0.24, from 1.49 in 2017Q3. The ratio turned negative, as 135 investment professionals increased and started new stock positions, while 108 sold and reduced holdings in BGC Partners Inc. The investment professionals in our database now possess: 128.38 million shares, up from 121.60 million shares in 2017Q3. Also, the number of investment professionals holding BGC Partners Inc in top ten stock positions decreased from 5 to 1 for a decrease of 4. Sold All: 26 Reduced: 82 Increased: 83 New Position: 52.
Augustine Asset Management Inc decreased General Electric (Ge) (GE) stake by 53.23% reported in 2017Q4 SEC filing. Augustine Asset Management Inc sold 24,095 shares as General Electric (Ge) (GE)’s stock declined 23.20%. The Augustine Asset Management Inc holds 21,170 shares with $369,000 value, down from 45,265 last quarter. General Electric (Ge) now has $127.46B valuation. The stock increased 0.51% or $0.075 during the last trading session, reaching $14.675. About 1.60M shares traded. General Electric Company (NYSE:GE) has declined 54.35% since May 14, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 65.90% the S&P500.
Another recent and important BGC Partners, Inc. (NASDAQ:BGCP) news was published by Seekingalpha.com which published an article titled: “BGC Partners’ (BGCP) CEO Howard Lutnick on Q1 2018 Results – Earnings Call Transcript” on May 04, 2018.
BGC Partners, Inc. operates as a brokerage firm servicing the financial and real estate markets worldwide. The company has market cap of $4.46 billion. It operates in two divisions, Financial Services and Real Estate Services. It has a 72.89 P/E ratio. The Financial Services segment provides brokerage services for fixed income securities, interest rate swaps, foreign exchange, equities, equity derivatives, credit derivatives, commodities, futures, and structured products.
Doheny Asset Management Ca holds 4.67% of its portfolio in BGC Partners, Inc. for 662,717 shares. Shikiar Asset Management Inc owns 474,570 shares or 3.36% of their US portfolio. Moreover, Silver Capital Management Llc has 2.64% invested in the company for 48,690 shares. The New York-based Bluemar Capital Management Llc has invested 2.15% in the stock. Cardinal Capital Management Llc Ct, a Connecticut-based fund reported 3.11 million shares.
The stock decreased 0.41% or $0.05 during the last trading session, reaching $12.1. About 30,352 shares traded. BGC Partners, Inc. (BGCP) has risen 22.29% since May 14, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 10.74% the S&P500.
